name: Narrow moving-pulse lead with delayed vibrato

scoreOwned: gate-off timing: without a gate-off cell before the next note the next note connects with no new envelope attack (songs/pink-panther/README.md native tempo-1 policy; in recipes the converter writes the cell, scripts/arrange-sidwizard.py gate_off_tick)

pitchSettlesAfterUpdates.detail: stock Extra at tempo 1 sets only the frequency high byte on a new note's first frame (reproduced: E4 first sounded about 75 cents flat), docs/songs/fuer-elise-native.md

character.summary: Gated pulse voice whose width starts near $200, rises, then oscillates inside a narrower band ($3EA to $5F7) than versions 1 and 2, with delayed vibrato and the longer release.

waveforms.detail: program data songs/axel-f/full-huelsbeck-pulse.json instruments.lead: wave table control bytes $41 = pulse + gate; frame1 $09 is the TEST frame and sounds no waveform

attack.detail: envelope attack nibble 0 = 2 ms (datasheet rate); spec thresholds hard <= 8 ms, medium <= 24 ms, soft >= 38 ms

body.detail: executed native snapshots: width starts $200, rises 29 steps of 35, then a 33-frame loop; nominal bounds $3EA-$5F7

release.detail: envelope release nibble 8 = 300 ms full-scale (datasheet rate); spec thresholds cut <= 24 ms, short <= 114 ms, medium <= 300 ms, long >= 750 ms

level.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; AC RMS dBFS over the first 250 ms and over 1.0-1.9 s of the note

brightness.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; spectral centroid divided by the fundamental over 0-60 ms and 50-550 ms (pure triangle about 1.0)

motion.detail: same snapshots; the width loop continues after the gate clears
vibrato $24 delay 12 as in the bank trace

avoid.condition: sustained held chord-top note (207 consecutive gated updates at 64.54-68.73 s): listener called it an annoying persistent sound, though the soft triangle substitute was preferred less

short high-register notes (97 notes A-flat5 to E-flat6, bodies 3-12 updates): every onset resets width to $200 and reaches at most $381, so the developed modulation never appears; triangle version was nicer

provenance.rights: MIT (original project instrument definition, no upstream preset bytes copied; the arrangement it is embedded in carries separate terms)
